hints.title: Monotonicity in Queries
hints.text: If a prefix of k queries is sufficient to reduce nums to all zeros, any larger prefix of queries >= k will also be sufficient.

hints.title: Binary Search Feasibility
hints.text: Binary search over the minimum prefix count k in [0, len(queries)].

hints.title: Range Sum Validation
hints.text: For candidate k, construct a difference array adding val at l and subtracting val at r + 1 for each query in queries[:k]. Check if cumulative coverage >= nums[i] for all i.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search on prefix query count k with linear difference array feasibility checking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating queries one by one without binary search leads to O(n * q) worst-case time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for difference array per check.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies monotonicity in query count k and uses binary search over prefix lengths.
